description: This file defines the custom annotation @DisableHandlers, used within the OpenMRS project to disable specific RequiredDataHandlers on collection fields. It includes metadata, licensing information, and documentation on how to use the annotation to prevent certain handlers from applying to annotated collections.

classes.name: DisableHandlers
classes.description: A custom annotation to disable specified RequiredDataHandler classes on annotated collection fields in OpenMRS.

methods.name: handlerTypes
methods.description: Returns the array of RequiredDataHandler classes that should be disabled for the annotated field.
